method: point mass BH, solar circular speed benchmark; no individual star mass inferred
notes: Solar circular field is inferred from v_c^2/R_0 and represents net inward dynamical radial force, not summation of observed 729 bright stars.
No physical mass or gravity is assigned to the 729 stations or bright-star catalog rows.
At r=0, point-mass formula is undefined; no acceleration assigned.

The ratio envelope varies black-hole mass by ±40000 solar masses, R0 by ±30 parsecs and circular speed by ±7 km/s, conservatively and independently. This is sensitivity, not a joint confidence interval.
